notes: Company background: mid-market B2B search SaaS for customer knowledge bases and in-app help. Heavy focus on response relevance and low cost per query.
Discovery call (2025-11-03): initial interest in Hosted API for quick MVP; product team wants embedding quality comparison vs current Pinecone+OpenAI pipeline.
Business drivers: reduce per-query infra spend, improve relevance for multi-lingual docs (EN/FR/DE), shorten index build time for nightly batches.
Technical constraints: hybrid ingestion pipeline (Kafka -> Spark batch -> vector DB), existing vector DB is self-hosted Milvus cluster in GCP; prefer minimal changes to ETL.
Security: SSO required (Okta/SAML), audit logs for queries, keys in KMS, need written answers for SOC2 and ISO27001 during procurement.
Latency/throughput targets: 95th pct <120ms for top-k retrieval path (embedding + kNN) for 80 QPS burst; batch embed jobs nightly: 10M docs / day target over weekend windows.
Model preferences: prefer open models for cost control but want Redwood-verified perf profiles; interested in quantized variants for Dedicated.
Routing/fallback: want Hosted for canary and Dedicated for steady traffic; fallback policy must route to lower-cost variant under high load with controlled quality impact.

POC plan: 2-week POC. Week 1: Hosted API embedding quality baseline (compare against OpenAI). Week 2: Dedicated sizing simulation using Redwood's bench + integration test with Milvus for retrieval latencies.
Quote from Head of Product: "We need to see both quality parity and 30-40% TCO improvement to justify migration."
Commercial posture: procurement expects committed year 1 for Dedicated if POC validates throughput and cost. Looking for guidance on burst capacity pricing.
SE notes (Maya): collect sample corpus (~200k docs) and attach to Drive; need mapping of current batch window and average doc size for embed sizing.
Recent ask from infra: confirmation that Redwood Dedicated supports VPC peering to GCP and can push logs to customer's SIEM (Splunk).
Risks: If embeddings quality slightly lower, product team will prefer multi-embedding ensemble; that increases per-request cost and changes POC success criteria.
Decision-makers: VP Product (primary), Head of Infra (security/ops signoff), CFO (budget).
Internal AE guidance: prioritize throughput report and an apples-to-apples embedding evaluation (same prompts, recall metrics).
Drive links provided in call: pricing workbook, security FAQ, POC acceptance criteria doc.
Next scheduled: throughput demo with Dedicated sizing 2026-03-15 (virtual).
